Description:
Execute up to 30 consecutive commands in sequence, each separated by semicolon

Syntax: Backlog <command1>; <command2>; <command3>...

Allowed values/notes: <commands>

Useful for device setup to avoid multiple restarts. Can be cleared by issuing Backlog without arguments.

Documentation: [Backlog](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#backlog)

Execute commands sequentially without delay between them

Syntax: Backlog0 <command1>; <command2>...

Allowed values/notes: <commands>

Documentation: [Backlog0](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#backlog0)

Execute commands without publishing results via MQTT or logging

Syntax: Backlog2 <command1>; <command2>...

Allowed values/notes: <commands>

Documentation: [Backlog2](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#backlog2)

Execute commands like Backlog but suppress result output

Syntax: Backlog3 <command1>; <command2>...

Allowed values/notes: <commands>

Documentation: [Backlog3](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#backlog3)

Set number of relay toggles (blinks)

Syntax: BlinkCount <value>

Allowed values/notes: 0, 1..32000

Does not control status LED

Documentation: [BlinkCount](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#blinkcount)

Set duration for power toggling during blink sequence

Syntax: BlinkTime <value>

Allowed values/notes: 2..3600

Documentation: [BlinkTime](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#blinktime)

Control button debounce timing

Syntax: ButtonDebounce <value>

Allowed values/notes: 40..1000

Documentation: [ButtonDebounce](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#buttondebounce)

Control buzzer output with various patterns

Syntax: Buzzer <count>,<beep>[,<silence>[,<tune>]]

Allowed values/notes: <count>, <beep>, <silence>, <tune>, -1, -2

Documentation: [Buzzer](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#buzzer)

Control fan speed (iFan02/iFan03)

Syntax: FanSpeed <speed>

Allowed values/notes: 0, 1..3, +, -

Documentation: [FanSpeed](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#fanspeed)

Set relay interlock mode and grouping

Syntax: Interlock <mode> [<group1> <group2>...]

Allowed values/notes: 0, 1

Groups separated by space; relays within group separated by comma

Documentation: [Interlock](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#interlock)

Control main LED power state

Syntax: LedPower <state>

Allowed values/notes: 0, 1, 2

Documentation: [LedPower](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#ledpower)

Configure LED indicator behavior

Syntax: LedState <mode>

Allowed values/notes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8

Documentation: [LedState](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#ledstate)

Skip inter-command delay for next Backlog command

Syntax: NoDelay

Use cautiously; best for simple commands

Documentation: [NoDelay](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#nodelay)

Control individual power output state

Syntax: Power<x> <state>

Allowed values/notes: 0 / off / false, 1 / on / true, 2 / toggle, 3 / blink, 4 / blinkoff

Also restarts PulseTime timer

Documentation: [Power](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#power)

Control all power outputs simultaneously

Syntax: Power0 <state>

Allowed values/notes: 0 / off, 1 / on, 2 / toggle

Documentation: [Power0](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#power0)

Lock power state to prevent further changes

Syntax: PowerLock<x> <state>

Allowed values/notes: 0, 1

Only PowerOnState and Interlock can change locked devices

Documentation: [PowerLock](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#powerlock)

Define power state when device powers up

Syntax: PowerOnState <value>

Allowed values/notes: 0 / OFF, 1 / ON, 2 / TOGGLE, 3, 4, 5

Documentation: [PowerOnState](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#poweronstate)

Auto-off timer for relay

Syntax: PulseTime<x> <value>

Allowed values/notes: 0 / OFF, 1..111, 112..64900

After timeout, power automatically turns OFF

Documentation: [PulseTime](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#pulsetime)

Control switch debounce timing and method

Syntax: SwitchDebounce <value>

Allowed values/notes: 40..1000

Documentation: [SwitchDebounce](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#switchdebounce)

Define switch behavior

Syntax: SwitchMode<x> <mode>

Allowed values/notes: 0..16

Index 0 applies to all switches

Documentation: [SwitchMode](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#switchmode)

Syntax: TimedPower<x> <state> <milliseconds>

Allowed values/notes: <state>, <value>

Issue TimedPower<x> without parameters to show remaining timers

Documentation: [TimedPower](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#timedpower)

Sets a pause between consecutive backlog commands

Syntax: Delay <value>

Allowed values/notes: 2..3600, -1, 1

Documentation: [Delay](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#delay)

Allowed values/notes: 0, 11..86400

Documentation: [DeepSleepTime](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#deepsleeptime)

Allowed values/notes: <value>

Documentation: [DeviceName](https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/#devicename)
